question: Observations 29, 32, 48, 50, x, x + 2, 72, 78, 84 and 95 are written in ascending order. If median of these observations is 63, then mean of the data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 10 observations, the median is the average of the 5th and 6th terms.

Median = (x + x + 2) ÷ 2 ⇒ x + 1 = 63 ⇒ x = 62.

The dataset values are: 29, 32, 48, 50, 62, 64, 72, 78, 84, 95.

Sum of all values = 29 + 32 + 48 + 50 + 62 + 64 + 72 + 78 + 84 + 95 = 614.

Mean = 614 ÷ 10 = 61.4.

**∴ The correct answer is 61.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations in ascending order: 29, 32, 48, 50, x, x + 2, 72, 78, 84, 95

Total number of observations (n) = 10

Median = 63

 Observations in Ascending Order
 
 
 29
